explanation: Constructs the complete reusable level family for one source pair. The loop writes all prescribed metadata records and payload catalogs while retaining both source-stage families throughout.
theorem_title: Building all prescribed shared reporting levels
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingLevels.program_meets {lim : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Limits} {μ : ℕ → ℤ}
    {record base h J K baseL baseR cellL cellR B D d : ℕ}
    (f g : Finset (Fin (J*(464*h))) → ℤ)
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hK : K ≤ _root_.ThreeSum.LightSwitchDepth.depth J+1)
    (hrecords : record+5*K ≤ base)
    (hcellL : cellL < record) (hcellR : cellR < record)
    (hdataL : baseL+(J*(464*h)+1)*_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.downsetCap (J*(464*h)) (2*h*J) ≤ record)
    (hdataR : baseR+(J*(464*h)+1)*_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.downsetCap (J*(464*h)) (2*h*J) ≤ record)
    (R : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingLevels.Resources lim base h J K B D d)
    (hf : ∀ S, S.card ≤ 2*h*J → |f S| ≤ B)
    (hg : ∀ S, S.card ≤ 2*h*J → |g S| ≤ D)
    (hleftRead : μ cellL=(baseL : ℤ)) (hrightRead : μ cellR=(baseR : ℤ))
    (hstoredL : _root_.ThreeSum.LightZetaStages.StoredThrough μ baseL (2*h*J) f (J*(464*h)))
    (hstoredR : _root_.ThreeSum.LightZetaStages.StoredThrough μ baseR (2*h*J) g (J*(464*h))) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingLevels.program 64 d
      [h,J,K,cellL,cellR,_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankLayout.localChoose h,_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankLayout.localPairs h,record,base] μ (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSharedReportingLevels.time h J K)
      (fun result ν => result=(_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankLevels.baseAt base h J K : ℤ) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankLevels.Built ν record base h J K f g ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν record ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.KeptBut μ ν base record (5*K)) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let two bounded integer functions on subsets of width $464hJ$ have stored stages through cutoff $2hJ$, identified by actual pointer cells. Let $K$ be at most terminal depth plus one. Suppose the $5K$ metadata slab precedes payload, all source data and pointers precede metadata, addresses fit words, and the complete per-level resource contract holds at the current depth. The closed program builds all $K$ reporting levels in its stated time, returns the exact next payload address, preserves memory before metadata, and changes earlier payload-prefix cells only within that metadata slab.

Constructs the complete reusable level family for one source pair. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
